annotations.title: Send feedback to the Praetorium team

description: Starts a new Support conversation as the signed-in player, the same as sending the Support page form, and returns its link. The team replies there, and the player sees the conversation and its replies on the Support page. Use it for a problem, an idea or a gap the player wants reported, such as a rule simulate_combat lists under notCalculated. Show the player the message and get their agreement before sending, and check list_my_feedback first so the same report is not sent twice. Pass the ids the tools returned in about rather than describing rules in your own words; the current data revision is added. Requires mcp:write.

about.description: Ids the tools returned for what the feedback is about, so the team can reproduce it.

faction.description: A faction slug or catalogue id.

notCalculated.description: Rule ids from a simulate_combat notCalculated list.

simulatorUrl.description: The simulatorUrl a combat tool returned, as given.

units.description: Unit ids, as list_units gives them.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

kind.description: Problem for something wrong, Idea for a request, Other for anything else.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

message.description: What the player wants the team to know, in their words or as they agreed: what happened, what they expected, and how to see it. The first line names the conversation.

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback to the Praetorium team
